title: ananas comosus
intro: Ananas comosus, commonly known as the pineapple, is a tropical plant species with edible fruit that belongs to the family Bromeliaceae. The health benefits of Ananas comosus include its anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as its antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Ananas comosus include its ability to support digestive health, boost immune function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Ananas comosus include bromelain, an enzyme with anti-inflammatory and proteolytic properties, as well as various vitamins and minerals such as vitamin C, manganese, and copper.
